title: Every Kit in Five Seconds
logline: All 48 Hardcore Games kits back to back, about five seconds each. One guy runs through every kit on three very patient test dummies, from the anchor to the wisp.
point: Every kit in the game, what each one does, in under five minutes.
premise: One player wants to show all 48 kits doing their signature thing, and has five seconds and three test dummies for each.
turn: Every few seconds the item in his hand changes and something new visibly happens to a dummy: a stick launch, a pit opening, a bedrock arena, a lightning strike on a tower.
final_image: Six identical copies of him, the Wisp and his decoys, walk apart across the snow and the field goes quiet.

setting.style: an open snowy plain used as a test range: bare snow, a small camp at the edge, and only the temporary things a kit needs (a pillar, a pool, a pit)

scenes.title: Anchor to Cookiemonster
scenes.summary: Opens wide on taborgreat at 1,2 (local) facing DummyOne, DummyTwo and DummyThree in a row. Anchor: sword blows traded with DummyTwo, nobody moves. Barbarian: three wooden sword hits kill DummyOne and the sword turns to stone. Beastmaster: three summoned wolves, a bone click on each, DummyTwo bitten. Berserker: a pig is killed, then DummyThree dies in three hits. Cannibal: cod hits, DummyTwo kneels to eat. Cookiemonster: a grass tuft punched, a cookie, a sprint away from the walking dummy. Events: wolves and a pig summoned and removed. DummyOne and DummyThree end dead. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. The flat working area is the west half (x -2692..-2679); a one block rise covers the east middle, where most cameras stand.

scenes.title: Cultivator to Fireman
scenes.summary: Cultivator: an oak sapling becomes a full tree in one tick (removed at the cut). Demoman: a stone plate on gravel at the north end, DummyTwo walks onto it, a power 4 explosion kills him. Digger: a dragon egg beside DummyThree, 30 ticks later a 5x5 pit 8 deep opens and he falls in. Endermage: a portal frame at the rim pulls DummyThree out of the pit to his side. Fighter: plain wooden sword hits traded with DummyOne. Fireman: fire under and around him, he is unhurt, DummyThree steps in and burns. The crater and pit are refilled after their slots. DummyTwo ends dead. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. The flat working area is the west half (x -2692..-2679); a one block rise covers the east middle, where most cameras stand.

scenes.title: Fisherman to Grandpa
scenes.summary: Fisherman: DummyTwo starts 11 blocks north and is reeled through the air to his feet. Flash: redstone torch, a 10 block teleport north with a real lightning bolt 4 blocks beside the arrival. Forger: raw iron, an ingot, then full iron armour (kept for the rest of the scene). Gambler: a stone button on the ground, a press, poison flashes. Gladiator: iron bars touch DummyOne and both stand in a sealed bedrock box in the sky (built for this scene only, removed at its end) where DummyOne dies after the 60 tick immunity. Grandpa: back on the ground, one stick hit sends DummyTwo 12.5 blocks. DummyOne ends dead. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. The flat working area is the west half (x -2692..-2679); a one block rise covers the east middle, where most cameras stand.

scenes.title: Grappler to Jackhammer
scenes.summary: DummyOne starts on top of an 8 block cobblestone pillar in the north west. Grappler: a cast and a 15 block flight across the field. Hades: a cow, a wolf and an iron golem summoned around DummyThree, an ingot click on each, the dummy mauled. Hermit: empty handed he walks off alone to the north edge. Horseman: a saddled armoured horse summoned beside him as a prop, fed hay. Hulk: DummyThree lifted onto his shoulders, a crouch to charge, a 19 block throw south. Jackhammer: a stone axe breaks the pillar base, the column goes block by block and DummyOne falls. Nobody dies. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. The flat working area is the west half (x -2692..-2679); a one block rise covers the east middle, where most cameras stand.

scenes.title: Jellyfish to Ninja
scenes.summary: Jellyfish: an empty hand puts real water at DummyTwo's feet for 60 ticks. Kangaroo: a rocket leap six blocks high over DummyTwo. Kaya: a pit hidden under ordinary ground in the north, he lays the last grass block and walks over, DummyTwo follows and drops through. Launcher: two stacked sponges, DummyThree sprints over them and is shot 8 blocks up. Monk: a blaze rod touch empties DummyOne's sword hand. Ninja: a hit, DummyOne sprints south, a crouch, and he is at the dummy's back. DummyTwo stays in the pit; nobody dies. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. The flat working area is the west half (x -2692..-2679); a one block rise covers the east middle, where most cameras stand.

scenes.title: Poseidon to Soulstealer
scenes.summary: taborgreat starts standing in a 5x5 pool one block deep. Poseidon: he knocks DummyTwo out of the pool twice (pool filled in at the cut). Pyro: a fire charge, a power 1.5 blast and fire beside DummyOne, who keeps flashing. Reaper: one hoe hit and DummyThree withers while running north. Scorch: leather boots and blaze powder, a ten block sprint east with real fire lit two blocks behind him; DummyTwo runs into it. Snail: two hits, DummyOne walks away and is sprinted down. Soulstealer: DummyOne kills him, he respawns under an invisibility effect, touches the dummy, appears with a stone sword and kills him. DummyOne ends dead. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. scenes.title: Spiderman to Thor
scenes.summary: An 8 block cobblestone tower with a ladder stands in the west. Spiderman: a snowball becomes a 2x2 of cobweb on DummyTwo, he sprints through it. Spy: he climbs the ladder with the compass out, already watching DummyThree sneak up. Stomper: he steps off the tower onto DummyOne (crouched) and DummyThree, all three flash. Switcher: a snowball and he and DummyTwo trade places across the field. Tank: his kill on DummyOne explodes at power 4 and he stands in the crater. Thor: he clicks the tower foot with a wooden axe, real lightning hits its top and DummyThree is knocked off it. DummyOne ends dead. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66. The flat working area is the west half (x -2692..-2679); a one block rise covers the east middle, where most cameras stand.

scenes.title: Timelord to Wisp
scenes.summary: Timelord: three dummies walk at him and freeze on the clock click; he frees DummyTwo with a hit. Turtle: crouched, he takes four blows, stands to hit back once. Vampire: he kills DummyTwo and turns straight on DummyOne. Viper: two hits and DummyThree flashes with poison. Werewolf: weak by day and knocked back, then the time jumps to night and he sprint-hits DummyThree dead. Wisp: back in daylight, five decoys with his skin (waiting in a room under the stage until then) appear beside him and all six walk off; DummyOne kills one and flinches. The last twelve seconds hold on the copies scattering over the snow. Natural snowy plains, set "range": origin -2678,66,1694, stage x -2692..-2665, z 1680..1707, feet at y 66.
